import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
# grid of mean colors, 16x9 cells
gh, gw = 9, 16
H,W,_ = im.shape
for gy in range(gh):
    line=''
    for gx in range(gw):
        cell = im[gy*H//gh:(gy+1)*H//gh, gx*W//gw:(gx+1)*W//gw].reshape(-1,3).mean(0)
        r,g,b = cell
        tag='?'
        if max(cell)-min(cell)<22 and cell.mean()>70: tag='G'
        elif r>g+12 and g>b+8: tag='S'  # skin/warm
        elif cell.mean()<55: tag='D'
        line+=tag
    print(line)
